description: Is this Base contract safe to interact with? Check whether an address is executable code, detect common proxy and pause signals, and return a bounded action verdict. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.02 to $0.1 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.
